## About
Demi Auto Care & Tires is a tire shop and repair garage on Convery Blvd in Perth Amboy. We sell new and used tires, handle alignments and TPMS sensors, and take care of general repairs, towing and junk cars.
We serve Perth Amboy and nearby towns like Woodbridge Township, Metuchen, Carteret, Port Reading, Avenel, Linden and Roselle. Before we fix anything, we show you what we're doing and give you a detailed written estimate.
Our customers have given us a 4.5 rating from 149 Google reviews. A lot of what they write about is straight talk and fair prices, and that's how we like to run the shop.

## Services
- New tires: Brand name new tires for all kinds of driving, mounted and balanced. ($60 and up)
- Used tires: Quality used tires when you need to keep costs down. ($50 and up)
- Tire rotation: Rotations to help your tires wear evenly and last longer.
- Tire repair: Repairs to get a damaged tire back on the road when it can be fixed.
- TPMS sensor replacement: We replace and reprogram tire pressure monitoring sensors.
- Alignment: Wheel alignments to keep your car tracking straight.
- Full-service auto repair: Engine diagnostics, brakes and general repairs on any year, make or model.
- Towing: Towing when your car won't go any further.
- Junk cars and scrap parts: We take junk cars and scrap parts off your hands.

## FAQ
Q: Do you sell used tires?
A: Yes. We carry used tires starting at $50 as well as new tires.

Q: What is your hourly mechanic rate?
A: Our hourly mechanic rate is $120.

Q: Will I know the cost before you start?
A: Yes. We show you what we're doing and give you a detailed written estimate on the repairs your vehicle needs.
